newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila stock market closed for All Saints Day.
newsitem.headline: Manila stock market closed for All Saints Day.

text.p: The Philippine Stock Exchange was closed on Friday for a national holiday marking All Saints Day when Filipinos visit cemeteries to pray by the graves of their dear departed ones.
The market reopens on Monday. On Thursday, the continuation of a three-day technical rally pushed the main index up by 36.70 points, or 1.25 percent to 2,964 points.
The shortened week ended Thursday saw the Philippine Stock Exchange index rising by a mere 1.4 points, or 0.047 percent, to 2,964 from 2,962.60 the previous Friday.

The week began with a steep fall, when the index fell by 110.44 points, or nearly 4 percent, to a seven-month low on Monday. A recovery in the next three days was attributed to a technical correction.
Stocks analysts said they expected the market to consolidate next week.
